### Integration Updates


- [Lytx](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/lytx) now supports[Trips](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/trip)
- [Motion ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/motion-eld-v2) now delivers richer[Historical Vehicle Locations](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/vehicle-location) with expanded tracking coverage and additional telemetry fields


### Dashboard Updates


- The[Terminal Dashboard](https://dashboard.withterminal.com/) now shows a pending deletion callout on connection pages, and admins can cancel pending deletions during the grace period


### API Updates


- Canceling a connection in` pending_deletion` now requires an admin role


### Consent Flow Updates


- [Netradyne](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/netradyne) Link setup now includes a built-in onboarding guide and validates Fleet Unique Identifier format during connection setup


### Documentation Updates


- Updated[Samsara configuration documentation](https://docs.withterminal.com/guides/samsara-oauth-configuration) to clarify that the user completing OAuth must have Full Admin or Standard Admin permissions
